lines.text: Most exoskeletons fight your body with motors and metal. Sitka works with it.
lines.sentiment: unease at the status quo, then 'oh, that's different'

lines.text: This is Sitka. Named after the tall Sitka spruce trees on the bluffs of Trinidad, California. Strong, light, and it bends without breaking.
lines.sentiment: quiet awe and a sense of place: 'that's beautiful'

low running shot on 'light'

he walks the bluff toward camera, smooth gait

lines.text: Your bones already carry the weight. Sitka adds what your muscles do, with springs, clutches, and cables that work like tendons.
lines.sentiment: 'oh, it's like a second set of tendons': understanding

setups.setup: ghosted body walks: the bones carry the weight

lines.text: Sit down anywhere, and a light pole under each hip takes most of your weight. A carbon spring at each knee catches you, and gives that energy back when you stand.

setups.setup: sit down outdoors, the struts deploy, wide
sit down, medium, from the other side

knee spring energy diagram (manim, overlay)

lines.text: Lean back, and two simple straps hold you, like a camp chair you wear.
lines.sentiment: comfort, a smile: 'like a camp chair'

setups.setup: lean back on the bluff, the straps take the load
lean back from the front three-quarter

orbit around the seated wearer as he leans back into the straps

lines.text: Bend to lift, and a tendon along your back stores energy. A fifteen kilo box feels about twelve kilos lighter, with no motor at all.

setups.setup: stoop lift of a box, side, tendon glows

lines.text: Walking and running, elastic bands link your hips, knees, and ankles, the way your own hamstrings and calves do.
lines.sentiment: ease and rhythm: it moves like you do

setups.setup: smooth walk on the bluff, tracking

lines.text: Want more? Smart clutches switch the springs on at exactly the right moment. And one small motor on your back helps only where you need it, on stairs, hills, and heavy lifts.
lines.sentiment: 'and when I need more, it's there': confidence

lines.text: It's fully modular. The seat and back kit weighs about fourteen pounds, and runs around two thousand dollars a set when it's built in small batches. Then add hips, ankles, shoulders, and power, all docking into one hub.
lines.sentiment: 'I can start small': it's within reach

lines.text: Most of the frame is 3D printed on a desktop printer, and every part is listed with its price, on GitHub.

lines.text: Sitka is completely open. The design, the math, every part. Come build one with us.
lines.sentiment: an open door: 'come build one with us'
